title: UAPI: GET_STATE missing finalized/error/iv_set fields for OPERATION fds
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info (crypto2dev_ioctl.h:367-376) does not include finalized, error, or iv_set fields. For a KEY fd, key_exportable is also absent. ioctl_get_state (fd.c:1132-1168) hard-codes initialized=1 and omits these. A support engineer or debugging tool calling GET_STATE cannot determine: whether the session has finalized, whether it is in the error state, whether an IV has been set for CBC/GCM, or whether a key is exportable. These fields exist in struct crypto2dev_fd_state; they need corresponding entries in the info struct.
